row.body: The house key is attached to a property map; the viewing sheet says the rooms were clear before the owner’s final walk-through.
row.title: The well-kept property

cites.quote: House and Land for Sale (listing no. 845)

sidecar.gloss: A property is marked clear before its last inspection.
sidecar.rival_reading: A routine sale could clear rooms before the owner returned; the map does not show who was inside.

row.body: the bar of soap and briefcase are tied with cut warning tape. six tally cuts mark the bar of soap; only four are crossed through.
row.title: missing count beside the bar of soap

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
